00111 Text Text::toUpper() const throw()
00112 {
00113     const char *thisArray = this->getArray();
00114     const int size = this->size();
00115     
00116     if(thisArray == 0 || size <= 0) return *this;
00117     
00118     Text newText = Text::withSize(size, false);
00119     char *newArray = newText.getArray();        
00120     
00121     for(int i = 0; i < size; i++)
00122     {
00123         char c = thisArray[i];
00124         
00125         if(c >= 'a' && c <= 'z')
00126             c -= 32;
00127         
00128         newArray[i] = c;
00129     }           
00130     
00131     return newText;
00132 }

00177 Text Text::replaceIgnoreCase(Text const& find, Text const& substitute) const throw()
00178 {
00179     Text thisLower = this->toLower();
00180     Text findLower = find.toLower();
00181     const int size = this->size();
00182     const int findLength = find.length();
00183     int startIndex = 0;
00184     int findIndex;
00185     
00186     Text result;
00187     
00188     while((findIndex = thisLower.indexOf(findLower, startIndex)) >= 0)
00189     {
00190         result <<= this->range(startIndex, findIndex);
00191         result <<= substitute;
00192         startIndex = findIndex + findLength;
00193     }
00194     
00195     result <<= this->range(startIndex, size);
00196     
00197     return result;
00198 }

00256 int TextArray::indexOf(Text const& item, const int startIndex) const throw()
00257 {
00258     const Text *array = this->getArray();
00259     
00260     if(array != 0)
00261     {
00262         const int length = this->length();
00263         for(int i = startIndex < 0 ? 0 : startIndex; i < length; i++)
00264         {
00265             if(array[i] == item)
00266                 return i;
00267         }
00268     }
00269     
00270     return -1;
00271 }
